note: Count of the entries of the official LEGO Fan CoLab community directory (successor of the LEGO Ambassador Network since 12 August 2026), read page by page (pages 1 to 9, 20 entries per page, 179 entries in total, matching the 179 Fan Communities shown on fancolab.lego.com). The directory merges former user groups (RLUG) and online communities and does not label the type of each entry, so the figures are recognized fan communities per country, not strictly RLUG. One entry with country 'Global' is excluded (178 counted). Country is the one displayed on each entry; Taiwan (TW) and Hong Kong (HK) are kept as displayed. The home page also says 'more than 200 Recognized Fan Communities', so the directory may be incomplete or lagging. Direct access is behind a Cloudflare challenge (not bypassed); the pages were read through a text reader, and page 6 returned empty on its plain address and was obtained through an address variant.
